mapper.select: SELECT sales_id AS salesId, goods_id AS goodsId, status FROM tb_goods_sales WHERE sales_id = #{salesId}

SELECT p.price_id AS priceId, p.seat_grade AS seatGrade, p.seat_grade_nm AS seatGradeNm, p.price AS price, COALESCE(a.remain_cnt, 0) AS remainCnt FROM tb_goods_salesprice p LEFT JOIN tb_goods_seatassign a ON a.sales_id = p.sales_id AND a.seat_grade = p.seat_grade WHERE p.sales_id = #{salesId} AND p.seat_grade = #{seatGrade} ORDER BY p.price DESC
